expanded_cap_manifest.policy: All historical Binance USDT instruments; no annual top-500 admission gate. No cap forward-fill. Current listings used only for identity evidence. Exact Sunday observations required.
expanded_cap_manifest.text_checksum_policy: UTF-8 CSV/JSON: accept original SHA256 or the stored reference SHA256 after replacing CRLF with LF. No other byte changes are normalized. Binary files require original SHA256.
